## Coinbase - Senior Software Engineer, Institutional Financing

🔗 [Apply](https://boards.greenhouse.io/coinbase/jobs/8248766)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior Software Engineer building backend financing systems that manage institutional loans for Coinbase’s crypto brokerage. Owning lending products, risk services, and resilient financial infrastructure.
Senior Software Engineer building financing systems for Coinbase’s institutional crypto brokerage
- Salary: $207,955 - $218,900 per year
- Tech stack: Cloud, Distributed Systems, GRPC, Java, Go
- Visa sponsorship signal: company profile says it sponsors H1B visas. Treat as a small scoring bonus, not a guarantee for this role.
- Design, build, and scale systems that safely manage billions of dollars in loans across Portfolio Margin, Trade Finance, Agency Lending, Bilateral Lending, and more
- Own the design and delivery of new financing products and features from architecture through production launch
- Build and maintain backend services, APIs, and frameworks supporting loan lifecycle management, risk calculations, and real-time position tracking
- Improve developer tooling, testing infrastructure, monitoring, and operational reliability across financing systems
- Partner with Product, Risk, Operations, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions
- Lead technical initiatives that strengthen system resilience, reduce operational risk, and support safe delivery
- 5+ years of backend software engineering experience, with production ownership of services handling high-reliability or financial workloads
- Proven track record designing, building, and scaling service-oriented architectures in Go, Java, or a comparable backend language
- Experience building and operating distributed systems where correctness, availability, and data integrity are critical
- Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, lead technical design reviews, and raise the bar on code quality across a team
- Familiarity with relational data stores, gRPC/Protobuf, and observability tooling in a cloud-native environment
- Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Software Engineer building backend financing systems that manage institutional loans for Coinbase’s crypto brokerage. Owning lending products, risk services, and resilient financial infrastructure.
Senior Software Engineer building financing systems for Coinbase’s institutional crypto brokerage
Role description:
• Design, build, and scale systems that safely manage billions of dollars in loans across Portfolio Margin, Trade Finance, Agency Lending, Bilateral Lending, and more
• Own the design and delivery of new financing products and features from architecture through production launch
• Build and maintain backend services, APIs, and frameworks supporting loan lifecycle management, risk calculations, and real-time position tracking
• Improve developer tooling, testing infrastructure, monitoring, and operational reliability across financing systems
• Partner with Product, Risk, Operations, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions
• Lead technical initiatives that strengthen system resilience, reduce operational risk, and support safe delivery
Role requirements:
• 5+ years of backend software engineering experience, with production ownership of services handling high-reliability or financial workloads
• Proven track record designing, building, and scaling service-oriented architectures in Go, Java, or a comparable backend language
• Experience building and operating distributed systems where correctness, availability, and data integrity are critical
• Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, lead technical design reviews, and raise the bar on code quality across a team
• Familiarity with relational data stores, gRPC/Protobuf, and observability tooling in a cloud-native environment
• Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality
